title: 5.3 Introduction to Websites
description: Websites concepts and details. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which statement compares static and dynamic sites?
options: Static sites also use server-side scripting
Both use databases for all pages

questions.question: A blog with personalized news feeds—which type of site?
A small business landing page—which type of site?
Which is an advantage of static websites?
options: They are simpler to create and host
They offer high flexibility for users
They generate pages on the fly
questions.correctAnswer: They are simpler to create and host

questions.question: Which is an advantage of dynamic websites?
options: They load faster than all other websites
They need no web server at all
They are simpler than static pages

questions.question: Which set contains only web page structure elements?
Which set contains only user-input form elements?
options: Hyperlinks, URLs and remote web servers

questions.question: What do HTML documents use to define layout?
options: Tags for headings, paragraphs and images
Cables for connecting many network devices
questions.correctAnswer: Tags for headings, paragraphs and images

questions.question: Which website purpose matches live chat support?
Which purpose matches discussion boards?
Which purpose matches streaming services?
Which purpose matches online stores?
Which statement about dynamic content is accurate?
options: Different content is shown from the same code
The same fixed content is always shown to everyone
Content is printed on paper copies
Content never changes for any user
questions.correctAnswer: Different content is shown from the same code

questions.question: Which statement about static content is accurate?
options: It stays the same until manually updated
It changes for every individual website visitor
It is generated by server-side scripts
It requires a database for each page
questions.correctAnswer: It stays the same until manually updated

questions.question: Which set lists only dynamic website uses?
options: E-commerce, social media and news portals
Landing pages, user manuals and brochures
questions.correctAnswer: E-commerce, social media and news portals

questions.question: Which set lists only static website uses?
options: Landing pages, small business sites, docs
Social media, blogs and online news portals
questions.correctAnswer: Landing pages, small business sites, docs

questions.question: What is the relationship between pages and a website?
options: A site is a collection of web pages
A page is a collection of many websites
They are two names for servers
They are types of network cables
questions.correctAnswer: A site is a collection of web pages

questions.question: Which step follows a user clicking a submit button?
options: The form input is sent for processing
The server deletes the entire web page
questions.correctAnswer: The form input is sent for processing

questions.question: Which element would a feedback form use for comments?
Which statement about website hosting is accurate?
options: Websites are hosted on web servers
Websites are hosted on client browsers
questions.correctAnswer: Websites are hosted on web servers
